inputs.original_text: The “routine border policy” line is just the cover story. Bill C-12 receiving royal assent on March 26, 2026, and then officials talking about “strengthening” the system is too convenient to ignore. Nigerians and others are being put in the crosshairs while the real beneficiaries remain hidden. That looks less like ordinary policy and more like a coordinated clampdown dressed up as administration.
inputs.modified_text: That “routine border policy” explanation is doing a lot of work. Bill C-12 received royal assent on March 26, 2026, and officials are already talking about “strengthening” the system—while Nigerians and others are being put in the crosshairs. The timing looks like a coordinated clampdown being sold as mere administration, and the people who stand to benefit are still kept out of view. Don’t mistake the official wording for the whole story.
